about_the_game:
Sex on the Beach (Kawaii, Cute Girl Vocal) is a music DLC soundtrack that blends playful Kawaii vocals with romantic summer vibes. Featuring electronic pop beats, a bright vocal performance, and warm summer tones, it’s the perfect companion for your beach adventures.

🌴 Overview
A vibrant, summer-inspired track that captures passion, freedom, and joy. With romantic lyrics and an expressive vocal, it feels like dancing barefoot on the sand under glowing skies.

🎶 Details

  • Electronic & pop elements with a summer vibe

  • Romantic, playful lyrics full of desire and connection

  • Cute Kawaii vocal for unique charm

  • Perfect for fans of J-Pop, summer hits, or chill-out playlists

✨ Key Features

  • High-energy yet relaxing soundtrack

  • Works for parties, casual listening, or ambience

  • Exportable as part of your Sex on the Beach game soundtrack

  • Adds extra atmosphere and immersion to the main game

content_descriptors.notes: The lyrics include the phrase "Sex on the beach", which, while a popular cultural expression, still carries a sexual undertone in the context of the song (e.g., "Touch me close," "passion," "hands that tease").
